rope.en: I told her not to let go of the rope, but she did.
rope.zh: 我叫她不要松开绳子，但是她做了。

reply.en: Please send me a reply as soon as you receive this mail.
reply.zh: 收到此邮件后请尽快给我答复。

regret.en: We apologize for the delay and regret any inconvenience it may have caused.
regret.zh: 我们对这次的延迟表示抱歉，并对可能造成的不便表示遗憾。

reading.en: I'll have finished reading this novel by the time you come tomorrow.
reading.zh: 你明天来的时候，我就看完这本小说了。

ridiculous.en: It would be ridiculous to spend all their money.
ridiculous.zh: 花光他们所有的钱会很荒谬。

real.en: Problems that can be solved with money are not real problems.
real.zh: 钱可以解决的问题都不是问题。

recently.en: Even though I enjoy bowling, I haven't gone bowling recently.
recently.zh: 虽然我享受打保龄球，但是我最近没有去打保龄球。

retire.en: I hope to retire from work when I'm 60 years old.
retire.zh: 我希望在六十岁时退休。

risk.en: It's a risk that Tom and I aren't willing to take.
risk.zh: 我和汤姆都不愿意冒这个险。

remote.en: The TV remote control is under the couch.
remote.zh: 电视遥控器在沙发下面。

remove.en: Visitors are usually asked to remove their shoes before they enter a Japanese house.
remove.zh: 访客通常在进入一户日本人家之前会被要求脱鞋。

revenge.en: They set fire to their neighbor's house in revenge.
revenge.zh: 为了报仇，他们放火烧了邻居的家。

rule.en: I make it a rule not to watch television after nine o'clock.
rule.zh: 我规定自己在九点之后不看电视。

recognize.en: You have changed so much that I can hardly recognize you.
recognize.zh: 你变了那么多，以至于我几乎认不出你了。

reach.en: In the U.S., most people can vote when they reach eighteen years of age.
reach.zh: 在美国，大多数人能在十八岁以后投票。

relax.en: Tom wanted to stay home and relax instead of hiking with his children.
relax.zh: 汤姆想待在家休息而不是和他的孩子们出去远足。

rather.en: I would rather go to the art museum than to the movie theater.
rather.zh: 我想去美术馆胜过去电影院。

roof.en: When Dad finds out what you've done, he's going to hit the roof.
roof.zh: 当爸爸发现你做了什么的时候，他会发疯的。

roll.en: He was absent at roll call.

rely.en: People rely too much on phones these days.

rescue.en: I'm going to help you rescue Tom.

rent.en: Tom can barely afford to pay rent let alone buy a PC.
rent.zh: 汤姆连房租都快付不起，更别说买一台电脑了。

regular.en: She visits the dentist on a regular basis, so she seldom gets toothaches.
regular.zh: 她定期去看牙医，所以她很少牙痛。

rotten.en: The oranges in this bag are rotten.
rotten.zh: 这个袋子里的柳橙都烂了。

rug.zh: 这块地毯是手工制作的。

require.en: An aging population will require more spending on health care.
require.zh: 老龄化的人口需要更多医疗保健支出。

race.en: A new team was formed in order to take part in the boat race.
race.zh: 为了参加划船比赛，一支新的队伍组成了。

respect.en: Respect for law is fundamental to our society.
respect.zh: 尊重法律是我们社会的基础。

resign.en: You should do the honorable thing and resign.

reservation.zh: 汤姆把酒店订单取消了。

ribbon.en: The girl wore a yellow ribbon in her hair.
ribbon.zh: 那女孩的头发上绑了一根黄丝带。

radium.en: It was Marie Curie who discovered radium.
radium.zh: 镭是居里夫人所发现的。

reap.en: As you sow, so shall you reap.

rock.en: Which do you like better, rock music or classical music?
rock.zh: 你比较喜欢哪一个，摇滚乐还是古典音乐？

relative.en: Tom is a distant relative of mine.

rare.en: All you have to do is take advantage of this rare opportunity.
rare.zh: 你所要做的便是好好把握这千载难逢的机会。

recent.en: The recent shortage of coffee has given rise to a lot of problems.
recent.zh: 近来咖啡的短缺造成了许多问题。

rainy.en: It was during the rainy season three years ago that Tom first met Mary.
rainy.zh: 三年前的雨季，汤姆第一次遇见了玛丽。

relevant.en: I thought his opinion was relevant.
relevant.zh: 我认为他的意见很中肯。

rocket.en: The rocket was launched into space.

rose.en: The girl brought me a red and a white rose.
rose.zh: 女孩给了我一枝红玫瑰和一枝白玫瑰。

raw.en: Japan imports various raw materials from abroad.
raw.zh: 日本从国外进口各种原料。

runner.en: The runner jumped over the hole in the ground.
runner.zh: 那个赛跑运动员跃过了地面上的洞。

recommend.en: I don't recommend eating in that restaurant. The food is awful.
recommend.zh: 我不推荐在那家餐馆吃饭。食物糟糕透了。

rid.en: Once you have formed a bad habit, you can't get rid of it easily.
rid.zh: 坏习惯一旦被养成，便不能简单地改正。

rude.en: He should apologize for being rude to the guests.
rude.zh: 他应该为自己对客人的粗鲁无礼而道歉。

remind.en: Let me remind you again that March 31st is the due date.
remind.zh: 让我再次提醒你3月31日是到期日。

rush.en: Fools rush in where angels fear to tread.
rush.zh: 天使畏惧处, 愚人敢闯入。

ruler.en: Draw a line with a ruler.

renew.en: I have to renew my passport.

reserve.en: I'd like to reserve a room in a hotel.

responsible.en: The captain is responsible for the safety of passengers.
responsible.zh: 船长要为乘客安全负责。

refrigerator.en: There's a bottle of white wine in the refrigerator.
refrigerator.zh: 冰箱里有一瓶白葡萄酒。

request.en: We are sorry we are unable to accept your request.
request.zh: 很抱歉，我们不能接受你的要求。

reliable.en: The weather forecast is not reliable at all.
reliable.zh: 天气预报一点也不可靠。

remain.en: Please remain seated for a few minutes.

rabbit.en: Rather than live a hundred years as a rabbit, live one day as a tiger.
rabbit.zh: 宁可当只老虎活一天，也不愿当只兔子过一百年。

romantic.en: He's a very romantic boyfriend who brings me flowers each night.
romantic.zh: 他是个非常浪漫的男朋友，每晚都给我送花。

rate.en: The unemployment rate in Japan was 3.4 percent in September of 2015.
rate.zh: 在2015年9月日本的失业率为3.4％。

repair.en: I will only buy the car if they repair the brakes first.
repair.zh: 除非他们事先修好刹车，我才会买车子。

reform.en: He proposed a reform in the educational system.
reform.zh: 他提议对教育系统进行改革。

responsibility.en: I take full responsibility for the action.
responsibility.zh: 我会为这次行动负起全责。

reasonable.en: Tom bought this camera for a reasonable price.
reasonable.zh: Tom用合理的价格买了相机。

react.en: If someone irritates you, it is best not to react immediately.
react.zh: 如果有人激怒你，你最好不要立刻做出反应。

repeat.en: Could you please repeat what you just said?
repeat.zh: 您可以再重复一遍刚才说的话吗？

racket.en: Where did you get this tennis racket?
racket.zh: 你从哪里弄来这把网球拍的？

robbery.en: He was in prison on a charge of robbery.

rarely.en: Sociopaths rarely display remorse or feelings of guilt for their crimes.
rarely.zh: 反社会者极少为他们的罪行显露懊悔或有罪恶的感觉。

resist.zh: 我抵抗不了甜食的诱惑。

result.en: Whether he comes or not, the result will be the same.
result.zh: 他来还是不来，结果是一样的。

relationship.en: I don't know anything about their relationship.
relationship.zh: 我对他们的关系一无所知。

recovery.en: There is no hope of his recovery.

railroad.en: The railroad is parallel to the road.

reduce.en: I have to reduce my expenses this month.

recover.en: Do you know how to recover a deleted file?
recover.zh: 你知道怎么恢复已删除的文件吗？

register.en: Could you please sign the register?
register.zh: 请您在登记册上签名好吗？

reduction.en: He advocated the reduction of taxes.

root.en: Money is the root of all evil.

relief.en: This medicine will give you some relief.

robot.en: How could I be a robot? Robots can't dream.
robot.zh: 我怎么可能是机器人呢？机器人不会做梦。

recorder.en: I got a video cassette recorder cheap at that shop.
recorder.zh: 我在那商店花低价买了台录像机。

rat.en: A cornered rat will bite a cat.

realize.en: Life begins when we realize who we really are.
realize.zh: 当我们明白真正的自己时，生活开始了。

roast.en: How about some more roast beef?
roast.zh: 再多一些烤牛肉怎么样?

rainbow.en: Did you see the rainbow this morning?
rainbow.zh: 你见到今天早上的彩虹了吗？

reputation.en: It's hard to maintain one's reputation.
reputation.zh: 维持一个人的声誉是很难的。

ridge.en: Is this the bus for Park Ridge?
ridge.zh: 这是去帕克里奇的巴士？

regularly.en: Are you taking any medicine regularly?
regularly.zh: 你经常服用任何药物吗？

rapidly.en: I felt my heart beating rapidly.
rapidly.zh: 我感觉我的心跳得很快。

response.en: I'm sorry for the late response.

respond.en: He didn't respond to my question.

refuse.en: I do not know whether to accept or to refuse.
refuse.zh: 我不知道是否该同意或拒绝。

recognition.en: She gave me a smile of recognition.
recognition.zh: 她给了我一个认可的微笑。

reflection.en: Tom looked at his reflection in the mirror.
reflection.zh: 汤姆看他在镜中的映像。

route.en: Whichever route you take, you will get there in time.
route.zh: 不管你选哪条路，你都能按时到那里。

rifle.en: He carried a rifle on his shoulder.
rifle.zh: 他把步枪背在他的肩上。

reverse.en: He did the reverse of what I asked.
reverse.zh: 他做的和我要求的相反。

reward.en: He is entitled to receive the reward.

revolve.en: The world doesn't revolve around you.

religion.en: I am interested in Chinese religion.

recall.en: I can't recall the last time we met.
recall.zh: 我想不起来我们上次见面的情况了。

roller.en: Which do you enjoy more, ice skating or roller skating?
roller.zh: 你更喜欢滑冰还是轮滑？

restless.en: I've been feeling a little restless.

revolution.en: After the revolution, France became a republic.
revolution.zh: 革命之后，法国成为了一个共和国。

radar.en: The ship is not equipped with radar.

range.en: We discussed a wide range of topics.
range.zh: 我们谈论了各种各样的话题。

relieve.en: No words can relieve her deep sorrow.
relieve.zh: 语言不能减轻她的悲痛。

record.en: His record is a new world record in the 100-meter dash.
record.zh: 他刷新了百米短跑的世界纪录。

retirement.en: His life after retirement was unhappy.
retirement.zh: 他退休后的生活不快乐。

resume.en: I don't worry so much about my resume.
resume.zh: 我对自己的履历不那么在意。

row.en: A beautiful woman was seated one row in front of me.
row.zh: 一个美丽的女人坐在我前面一排。

remarkable.en: In recent years, science has made remarkable progress.
remarkable.zh: 这几年，科学取得了显著的进步。

refusal.en: I interpreted her silence as a refusal.
refusal.zh: 我认为她的沉默就是表示拒绝。

roman.en: I'm looking for books on Roman history.
roman.zh: 我在找关于古罗马历史的书。

region.en: A string of disasters struck the region.
region.zh: 一连串的灾难袭击这个地区。

rob.en: Tom and his friends planned to rob a bank.
rob.zh: 汤姆和好友打算抢银行。

role.en: Nature plays an important role in our life.
role.zh: 大自然在我们的生活中扮演着重要的角色。

represent.en: The blue lines on the map represent rivers.
represent.zh: 地图上的蓝线代表河流。

reunion.en: Tom went to Australia for a family reunion.
reunion.zh: 汤姆去澳大利亚与家人团聚。

rapid.en: I'm amazed at his rapid progress in English.
rapid.zh: 我被他英语的快速进步惊呆了。

roughly.en: Asia is roughly four times the size of Europe.
roughly.zh: 亚洲的大小约四倍于欧洲。

reality.en: She looks young, but in reality she's over 40.
reality.zh: 她看起来是年轻的，但实际上她四十多岁了。

republic.en: After the revolution, France became a republic.
republic.zh: 革命之后，法国成为了一个共和国。

rust.en: A bicycle will rust if you leave it in the rain.
rust.zh: 如果你把自行车留在雨中，它会生锈的。

recommendation.en: Tom got the job on the strength of your recommendation.
recommendation.zh: 多亏了你的推荐，汤姆得到了那份工作。

reef.en: The coral reef is the region's prime attraction.
reef.zh: 珊瑚礁是这个地区的主要景点。

respectful.en: Be respectful to your superiors, if you have any.
respectful.zh: 如果你有上司的话，学会尊敬他（她）。

retreat.en: I was uncertain whether to advance or to retreat.
retreat.zh: 我不确定该前进还是后退。

refresh.en: Moderate exercise will refresh both mind and body.
refresh.zh: 适度的运动让身心焕然一新。

research.en: If we knew what we were doing, it wouldn't be called research, would it?
research.zh: 如果我们知道我们在做什么，那么这不能称之为研究，是吗？

replace.en: Please replace the empty ink cartridge in the printer.
replace.zh: 请把打印机里面的空的墨粉鼓换掉。

resemblance.en: I was surprised at his strong resemblance to his father.
resemblance.zh: 他像极了他父亲，这让我震惊。

riot.en: There was only one warden on duty when the riot started.
riot.zh: 暴动开始时只有一位监狱长值班。

radiation.en: The ozone in the stratosphere absorbs ultraviolet radiation.
radiation.zh: 平流层的臭氧会吸收紫外线。

resolution.en: My New Year's resolution is to learn how to play the ocarina.
resolution.zh: 我新年的愿望是学会吹奥卡利纳埙。

recite.en: What I hate most of all is having to recite texts from memory.

rise.en: The recent shortage of coffee has given rise to a lot of problems.
rise.zh: 近来咖啡的短缺造成了许多问题。

revise.en: In the light of what you told us, I think we should revise our plan.
revise.zh: 根据你所说的话，我认为我们应该重新审视我们的计划。

remains.en: The crash was and remains to date the deadliest airplane accident on Canadian soil.
remains.zh: 这起空难是迄今为止加拿大境内最严重的空难。

representative.en: If you would like to speak to a customer service representative, please press three.
representative.zh: 如果想与客服代表通话，请按三。

repeatedly.en: I can't believe you are eating something the doctor has told you repeatedly you shouldn't eat.
repeatedly.zh: 真的不敢相信你在吃医生叮嘱不要食用的东西。
